parameters.title: Gantt plan parameters
parameters.description: The data an agent sends for a Gantt plan (FR-15): the work breakdown whose leaves are its tasks, the plan's start, and each task's finish-to-start predecessors. Each is checked by the same definitions as a Gantt's props. The plan's names, durations and order come from its work breakdown.

workPackages.description: The ID of the Tree item, in the same question, whose leaves are the plan's tasks.

start.description: The plan's start: work starts on the first working day on or after it.

dependencies.description: Each task's predecessors, finish to start, by task ID.
